title: Combined activity feed — all permitted event types, reverse chronological
objective: Verify GET /assets/:uuid/activity merges lifecycle, assignment, transfer, maintenance, stocktake, comment, and status events into one reverse-chronological feed with actor, timestamp, type, summary.
preconditions: Asset exercised through create → assign → transfer → maintenance → stocktake observation → note.
test_data: asset AF1 run through each workflow
steps: GET /assets/AF1/activity; verify every event type present, ordered newest-first, each with actor/timestamp/type/summary.
expected_result: Feed complete and correctly ordered; no duplicate/missing events; timestamps UTC; correlation IDs present where applicable; UI history tab renders the same feed.

title: Activity feed hides sensitive details by permission
objective: Verify feed entries omit financial details (maintenance cost, purchase price) and restricted personal data for roles without permission, while finance-capable roles see them.
preconditions: AF1 includes a maintenance event with cost and an assignment to an employee.
steps: GET activity as operator; scan summaries/details for cost amounts.
GET activity as auditor; verify cost visible.
expected_result: No financial values in operator feed payloads (including nested details JSON); auditor view complete; no leakage via summaries or error messages.

title: Data-quality rules flag missing/invalid/inconsistent data (v1)
objective: Verify the v1 rule engine flags: missing required fields, invalid references, possible duplicates, expired assignments, inconsistent lifecycle values; errors vs warnings distinguished. GET /data-quality/issues returns the queue.
preconditions: Seeded/created assets exhibiting each issue class (seed data quality fixtures or crafted via API where validation allows drafts). Mandatory backend tests land in Cycle 3 (design §2.5).
test_data: asset missing serial (if required by category); asset with expired expected_return; duplicate serial pair; status/assignment inconsistency
steps: Verify each seeded issue flagged with rule id, severity (error vs warning), and asset reference.
expected_result: Each seeded issue detected and classified per documented rules; severity mapping correct; flags scope-filtered; no false positives on clean seeded assets (spot check).

title: Data-quality work queue — resolution preserves audit history
objective: Verify flagged issues appear in a resolvable work queue; POST /data-quality/issues/:uuid/resolve (or fixing underlying data) clears the flag while preserving the full audit trail.
preconditions: Assets with open data-quality flags; operator/manager session.
test_data: one fixable issue (add missing field), one acknowledged warning
steps: Open the work queue (API or UI per delivery); verify flags listed with severity.
Fix the underlying data via normal edit (version-checked) or the resolve endpoint; verify flag clears on re-evaluation.
Verify audit history retains the original state + correction events.
expected_result: Queue accurate and permission-scoped; resolution via normal audited mutations; history immutable and complete; UI queue states (loading/empty) correct.

title: Dashboard completion — full KPI set, scope-correct, links to filtered lists, refreshed timestamp
objective: Verify dashboard summary includes all Cycle-2/3 KPIs (totals, by status, by category, assigned/unassigned, overdue returns, maintenance due, warranty expiring, missing, recent activity), scoped per user, with working links and last-refreshed timestamp. (Renumbered from duplicate TC-FR-020-01 in Cycle 3 design phase; complements dashboard.json TC-FR-020-04.)
preconditions: Seeded data incl. overdue assignment, due maintenance, expiring warranty, missing asset; admin + dept-scoped deptmgr sessions. Mandatory backend KPI tests land in Cycle 3 (design §2.5).
test_data: ground-truth counts computed via filtered /assets queries
steps: GET /dashboard/summary as admin and as deptmgr; verify KPI counts against ground truth per scope (no cross-scope totals for deptmgr).
Open dashboard UI; click each indicator; verify landing list is correctly pre-filtered.
Verify last-refreshed timestamp renders; verify tasks/activity panels per Cycle-2/3 scope.
expected_result: Counts reconcile exactly per scope; links deep-link to filtered lists (URL query params); timestamp displayed; dashboard p95 ≤3s on seeded volume (smoke measurement recorded); accessible ranked lists/table fallback present (D-15).

title: Performance smoke — dashboard/search/detail latencies on seeded volume
objective: Smoke-measure latencies (repeated samples) for dashboard summary, filtered asset search, and asset detail; record numbers. Cycle 3 extends to planning-volume run (see hardening-c3.json TC-NFR-006-01).
preconditions: Running seeded stack; timing harness (pytest/Playwright/curl loop).
test_data: 20 samples per endpoint; warm and cold first-hit noted
steps: Measure GET /dashboard/summary, GET /assets?<typical filter>, GET /assets/<uuid> repeatedly; record min/median/max.
Verify no endpoint degrades egregiously (targets: dashboard ≤3s, search/detail ≤2s).
expected_result: Measured latencies within targets (recorded as evidence; full planning-volume perf test is TC-NFR-006-01); no obvious N+1 regressions (backend assertNumQueries tests remain green).
